name: caption_localizer_natural_dev_v2
failure_rule: Retain all 680 videos and 1020 pairs. Missing candidate scores are incorrect in the full denominator; also report coverage. No score-based subset selection.
coco80_ablation: Reconstruct zero base masks on caption-fallback frames; reuse only the identical actual-frame CLIP patch features. No construction or clean-variant mask reuse.
comparison: Report paired accuracy change against both official origin and existing frozen19 repair. Development assessment only; no new independent heldout claim.
supersedes: v1 natural evaluation was prepared but not run; full-frame dev localization exposed parser/confidence issues before launch.
